legal_units.title: Special provision in case of interest income of specified financial institutions.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in this Act, the interest income in relation to bad or doubtful debts of a specified financial institution shall be chargeable to tax under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession" in the tax year in which such interest is— whichever is earlier.
